cues.en: So we've had a look at developing neural networks using TensorFlow's lower level API's.
cues.zh: 我們已看過如何使用 TensorFlow 較低階 API，開發神經網路。

cues.en: Where instead of thinking about neurons or units you're thinking more about tensors and matrices and multiplying them together directly.
cues.zh: 不從神經元或單元思考，而是直接思考張量、矩陣，以及如何相乘。

cues.en: And that's a very efficient way of doing it but it's not really intuitive.
cues.zh: 這是很有效率的方法，但不直覺。

cues.en: It can be a little bit confusing especially when you're trying to implement a neural network in those terms.
cues.zh: 尤其試著用這種方式實作神經網路時，可能有點混淆。

cues.en: Fortunately there's a higher level API called Keras that's now built in to TensorFlow.
cues.zh: 幸好，現在 TensorFlow 內建一個叫做 Keras 的高階 API。

cues.en: It used to be a separate product that was on top of TensorFlow but as of TensorFlow 1.9 it's actually been incorporated into TensorFlow itself as an alternative higher level API that you can use.
cues.zh: 它以前是架在 TensorFlow 上的獨立產品，但從 TensorFlow 1.9 起，已整合進 TensorFlow 本身，作為另一個可用的高階 API。

cues.en: And it's really nice because it's purpose built for deep learning.
cues.zh: 它很棒，因為專門為深度學習設計。

cues.en: So all the code is very much built around the concept of artificial neural networks.
cues.zh: 因此，所有程式碼，都圍繞人工神經網路概念。

cues.en: That makes it very easy to construct the layers of your neural network and wire them together, and use different optimization functions on them.
cues.zh: 這讓建立神經網路各層、彼此連接，以及套用不同最佳化函數，都很容易。

cues.en: It's a lot less code and a lot less that can go wrong as a result.
cues.zh: 程式碼少得多，因此可能出錯的地方也少得多。

cues.en: Another benefit of Keras in addition to its ease of use is its integration with the scikit_learn library.
cues.zh: 除了易用，Keras 另一個優點，是與 scikit-learn 函式庫整合。

cues.en: If you're used to doing machine learning in Python you'd probably use scikit_learn a lot.
cues.zh: 如果習慣用 Python 做機器學習，應該經常使用 scikit-learn。

cues.en: Keras can actually integrate your deep neural networks with scikit_learn.
cues.zh: Keras 能讓深度神經網路與 scikit-learn 整合。

cues.en: You may have noticed in our previous lecture that we kind of glossed over the problem of actually doing train tester cross-validation on our neural network.
cues.zh: 你可能注意到，上一堂大致略過了對神經網路進行訓練／測試或交叉驗證的問題。

cues.en: Because it would have been rather difficult to implement.
cues.zh: 因為實作會相當困難。

cues.en: But with scikit_learn it's very easy to do cross-validation and perform proper analysis and evaluation of this neural network.
cues.zh: 但有 scikit-learn，就很容易做交叉驗證，適當分析與評估神經網路。

cues.en: That makes it easier to validate what we're doing and to integrate it with other models.
cues.zh: 這讓驗證工作，以及與其他模型整合，更容易。

cues.en: Or even chain a neural network with other deep-learning or machine learning techniques.
cues.zh: 甚至能把神經網路，與其他深度學習或機器學習技術串接。

cues.en: There's also a lot less to think about.
cues.zh: 需要思考的東西，也少得多。

cues.en: And that means that you can often get better results without even trying.
cues.zh: 因此，往往不用刻意努力，就能得到更好結果。

cues.en: With TensorFlow's original API you have to think about every little detail at the linear algebra level of how these neural networks are constructed because it doesn't really natively support neural networks
cues.zh: TensorFlow 原始 API 中，必須在線性代數層次，考慮神經網路如何建構的每個小細節，因為它本身並不直接提供

cues.en: out of the box.
cues.zh: 神經網路支援。

cues.en: You have to figure out, how do I multiply all the waves together?
cues.zh: 必須想出，如何把所有權重相乘？

cues.en: How do I add in the bias terms?
cues.zh: 如何加入偏差項？

cues.en: How do I apply an optimizer to it?
cues.zh: 如何套用最佳化器？

cues.en: How do I define a loss function?
cues.zh: 如何定義損失函數？

cues.en: In contrast, Keras can take care of a lot of those details for you.
cues.zh: 相較之下，Keras 能替你處理許多細節。

cues.en: Why is that important?
cues.zh: 為什麼重要？

cues.en: Well the faster you can experiment and prototype things the better your results will be.
cues.zh: 實驗與製作原型越快，結果就越好。

cues.en: If it's that much easier for you to try different layers in your neural network, different topologies, different optimizers, different variations, it's going to be that much easier and quicker
cues.zh: 如果更容易嘗試不同層、不同拓樸、不同最佳化器、不同變形，就能更容易、更快地

cues.en: for you to converge on the optimal neural network for the problem you're trying to solve.
cues.zh: 找到適合問題的最佳神經網路。

cues.en: The more time you can spend on the topology and tuning of your neural network and the less on the implementation of it the better your results will be.
cues.zh: 花越多時間在拓樸與調整，越少時間在實作，結果就越好。

cues.en: You might find that Keras is ultimately a prototyping tool for you.
cues.zh: 你可能最後把 Keras 當成原型工具。

cues.en: It's not as fast as just going straight to TensorFlow.
cues.zh: 它沒有直接使用 TensorFlow 那麼快。

cues.en: Sometimes you want to converge on the topology with Keras and then go back and implement that at the lower level TensorFlow layer.
cues.zh: 有時，可以先用 Keras 找到拓樸，再回頭以較低階 TensorFlow 實作。

cues.en: But again, just that ease of prototyping alone is well worth it.
cues.zh: 但再次強調，光是容易做原型，就非常值得。
